description: Nobody ranks on page one chasing "SEO" or "marketing." Those terms are owned by sites with a decade of authority and thousands of backlinks. Go long-tail instead. "Best email subject lines for real estate agents" beats "email marketing" every time. Less competition, real searchers, actual rankings. Stack enough 200-1,000 search/month keywords and the traffic adds up fast. #SEO #KeywordResearch #DigitalMarketing #NeilPatel
transcript: I can't believe I'm telling you this because it's literally how I built my traffic to millions of visitors a month. But most of you are chasing the wrong keywords. Everyone goes after the big terms, marketing, SEO, how to make money, millions of searches a month, and they wonder why they're on page 47 of Google. They're competing against sites with tens years of authority and thousands of backlinks. You will not win that fight, not right now at least. Here's what I did instead. I stopped going after obvious keywords and started targeting the specific ones. Not email marketing, but the best email subject lines for real estate agents. That's a conversation almost no one's having. And if you do that for thousands of keywords, what you'll find is you can build up a lot of traffic and AI can even help you. So here's the steps I take. I go to uberse.com, type in a keyword related to my space, and it shows me all the questions that people are typing into Chat GBT right now. I then go and create content around those keywords using their AI. Write, start off with that and you'll start generating more than that.
